title: The Beverly Gardens job in New Orleans
summary: His only job in New Orleans before leaving again, a few months at Beverly Gardens with Dela Roe, Bonnie Potter and George Schilling.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Well you went on that show and you came back here, I got confused now, you played at the Beverly Gardens.
That's the only job I had in New Orleans before I went to the Harrow Office when I went to the Stairway 10 years.
Were you there at the Beverly Gardens a while?

About three months or something like that. And whose band was that one? I don't know who was the leader of the band here. It was like I tell you, Dela Roe on piano and Bonnie Potter on bass, George Shilling, and Paul Piquet, and I can't think of the dumbest name from them. I don't know who actually was the leader of the band, but it was Dela Roe and Ben the Piano player and the big job I'm not sure.
Well don't worry about it. I just can't get these things straight.
Like I said, that was the only job I worked in New Orleans and then I went away until I came back in 76.
